perspectives.text: Under the Agreement, the Executive faces several restrictions after employment ends. For twelve (12) months after the employment ends, the Executive shall not work for a competitor of the Company in the United Kingdom [1]. Additionally, for six (6) months after the employment ends, the Executive shall not solicit any customer of the Company with whom the Executive dealt in the last year of employment [1]. Each restriction is a separate covenant and is reduced by any time the Executive spends on garden leave [1].
